statement: Unlock the obol altar first; it is in the World 2 town just above the shop.
A cat sleeping on the altar can only be woken with the Bob Joe Pickle from the World 2 shop.
Interacting with the altar gives a quest to scare the cat; buy a Bob Joe Pickle from the W2 shop and drop it on the cat.
Obol storage holds obols from monster drops, Alchemy purchases and obol stacks, with one tab per shape: circle, square, hexagon, sparkle.
Personal tab obols give bonuses only to the current character; only a few slots are open at first and the rest are locked by class level.
Family tab obols give bonuses to all characters; slots unlock based on total account level (combined level of all characters).
Most early obols should go in the family tab so every character benefits.
Totals tab shows all bonuses your characters get from family and personal obols.
Upgrades tab lets you roll (reroll) combine or fragment obols; rerolling and combining need fragments and money.
Get obol fragments by recycling obols or from the arcade; amount received depends on the obol's rarity.
Obols have five rarities: bronze, silver, gold, platinum, dementia; shape typically changes as rarity rises.
Strength, agility, wisdom and luck obols start as bronze circles and stay circles until becoming squares at dementia rarity.
Most obols found are bronze or silver; use the combine function to reach gold platinum or dementia.
Combining requires two obols of the same type and same rarity; you cannot fuse different rarities.
Combining has a percentage chance to succeed so failed attempts cost more fragments and money; low rarities can lose an obol on failure (clearly indicated).
On success the obol in the right slot disappears and the left slot obol upgrades to higher rarity.
Rerolling costs fragments and money and can raise or lower stats, e.g. a bronze 2% drop rate obol going to 3% or 1%; may add or remove extra stats.
The left slot obol keeps its rolled stats after successful fusion; this can save fragments.
Some obols cannot have certain misc stats upgraded (chopping obol cannot gain chopping power) so aim for the main stat.
Old personals tab shows all characters' personal obol tabs; swap obols between characters or equip directly from storage via the two character heads.
You cannot unequip obols back to storage from the old personals tab.
Creator gives personal recommended obol builds and farming spots; the full list is on the wiki linked in the description.
Off-stat flex build (main stats off-stat) makes you decent at everything; suited to lazy players who don't want frequent swaps especially early.
Silver strength obols farmed at Fort Beans? with the DK crystal build.
Silver agility obols farmed at Sandy Pots with the DK crystal build.
Silver wisdom obols farmed at Sand Castles with the DK crystal build.
Silver luck obols farmed at Snelbies? with the DK crystal build.
All the off-stat silver obols can simply be farmed at Sand Castle since it's a crystal farm.
Hexagon obols for combat damage can be farmed from the boss Chizoar.
Hexagon obols for skill efficiency come from the World 3 mini boss (Dilapidated Slush?).
Troll boss sparkle obol gives all stat.
Multi-kill build is ideal for pushing content quickly.
Farm bronze circle multi-kill obols at Boxes? or Dead Rams? using the DK crystal build then upgrade all the way to sparkle.
Chopping and mining obol setup is beneficial but tedious.
Chopping and mining obols come only from the Alchemy shop or obol stacks and take weeks to get.
Equip chopping and mining obols everywhere except hexagon slots where dilapidated slush obols are better.
Drop rate build is the best stat and ultimate lazy build: more loot for combat and more statues for skilling.
Farm pop? obols from Gigafrogs using elemental sorcerer with a drop rate build; take them up to silver circles.
Dice obols are farmed at Sand Castles with the DK crystal build; go from squares all the way to sparkles.
Replace square obols with Ice Guard? obols from the once-a-day random events for higher drop rate.
Replace hexagon obols with the World 5 mini boss obols (Magma? Doo?) for drop rate.
Best obol is the Molen? Obol of the Dead Divine sparkle: 7 weapon power, 5% all AFK gains, 2% total damage.
Use the Dead Divine obol to replace the majority of sparkle obols if doing any AFK gains.
Hyper obols are better but cost lots of money and limited-time shop FOMO; spend gems on something better instead.
Obol storage is limited; more can be bought in the gem shop but it is still not enough.
Worship trapping and construction obols exist but he hasn't found a spot where they're worth swapping into the builds.
